answer_2.quote: We introduce a metric Dependency Accuracy (DA): ... By multiplying SER with DA, we compute the Logical Pass Rate (LPR) of the planning task as a quantitative assessment ... Additional metrics such as Sub‑mission Adoption Rate (SMAR), Fictional APP detection accuracy (FD‑APP), Operation space compliance accuracy (OSC), Fictional API detection accuracy (FD‑API), Parameter compliance accuracy (PC) and Temporal reasoning accuracy (TR) are also used.

answer_3.quote: Given the complexity of the dataset, manual evaluation is impractical, and we currently rely on automated evaluation using LLMs.
